content: Obsidian daily notes are plain markdown files opened per-day via a core/community plugin, extended by a large plugin ecosystem for auto-tagging (AI classification), saved search templates, task rollover across days, and tag-filtered random note surfacing. Obsidian's native tag search treats tags as exact-string with autocomplete from existing vault tags; nested tags via '/' are supported but there is no built-in fuzzy/typo-tolerant matching or automatic near-duplicate tag merging.
